_README: Q299 cross-section coverage audit: scripts/anatomy/q299/xsec299.js, 30 axial levels per region per page (7 regions = 210 levels per page), measured on the SHIPPED pages (build/q299).
SHOULD appear = the plane cuts the structure (its triangles straddle it). DOES appear = pixels of the FINAL cut-face raster still carry its code after every later structure has painted over it.

'before' = the cut-face kernel as it shipped up to Q298; 'after' = the same page with the Q299 minimum drawn width (band = 1/500 of the section extent, capped at 2.5 mm, never thinner than one raster pixel). Same geometry on both sides, so the difference is the kernel change alone.

Q295 cross-check: the filled area of the whole cut face (union of every structure section) at five axial levels per female page, before (build/q297 geometry + the Q297 kernel) and after (build/q299 geometry + the Q299 minimum drawn width). The band only adds pixels, so the area must not fall anywhere.
q295_fill_crosscheck.units: mm2 at a 1.0 mm raster; [before, after]
